WITH new_york_city AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "city"
    WHERE LOWER("name") = 'new york'
),
hotels_in_ny AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE h."city_id" = (SELECT "id" FROM new_york_city)
),
hotels_with_pool AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name", TRUE AS "has_swimming_pool"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE h."city_id" = (SELECT "id" FROM new_york_city)
      AND LOWER(lf."feature") = 'swimming pool'
),
hotels_with_hot_tub AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name", TRUE AS "has_hot_tub"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE h."city_id" = (SELECT "id" FROM new_york_city)
      AND LOWER(lf."feature") = 'hot tub'
)

SELECT
    hin."name" AS "hotel_name",
    COALESCE(hwp."has_swimming_pool", FALSE) AS "has_swimming_pool",
    COALESCE(hwht."has_hot_tub", FALSE) AS "has_hot_tub"
FROM hotels_in_ny hin
LEFT JOIN hotels_with_pool hwp ON hin."id" = hwp."id"
LEFT JOIN hotels_with_hot_tub hwht ON hin."id" = hwht."id"
ORDER BY hin."name";

WITH ny_hotels AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
    WHERE LOWER(c."name") = 'new york'
),
pool_hotels AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h."id", h."name", 'Swimming Pool' AS feature_type
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") = 'swimming pool'
    AND h."id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM ny_hotels)
),
hot_tub_hotels AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h."id", h."name", 'Hot Tub' AS feature_type
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") = 'hot tub'
    AND h."id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM ny_hotels)
)
SELECT "name" AS hotel_name, feature_type
FROM pool_hotels
UNION ALL
SELECT "name" AS hotel_name, feature_type
FROM hot_tub_hotels
ORDER BY hotel_name, feature_type;

WITH tourist_attractions_visitors AS (
    
    SELECT DISTINCT t."name" AS tourist_name
    FROM "tourists" t
    JOIN "visitrecords" vr ON t."id" = vr."touristattractionid"::BIGINT
    WHERE t."activity" LIKE 'Tourist Attraction'
      AND t."location" LIKE 'Portobello'
),
local_markets_visitors AS (
    
    SELECT DISTINCT t."name" AS tourist_name
    FROM "tourists" t
    JOIN "visitrecords" vr ON t."id" = vr."localmarketid"::BIGINT
    WHERE t."activity" LIKE 'Local Market'
      AND t."location" LIKE 'Portobello'
)

SELECT
    ta.tourist_name AS "tourist_attraction_visitor",
    lm.tourist_name AS "local_market_visitor"
FROM tourist_attractions_visitors ta
FULL OUTER JOIN local_markets_visitors lm ON ta.tourist_name = lm.tourist_name
ORDER BY ta.tourist_name ASC NULLS FIRST, lm.tourist_name ASC NULLS FIRST;

WITH common_requirements AS (
    
    SELECT jr.requirement_id
    FROM job_postings_requirements jr
    GROUP BY jr.requirement_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT jr.job_posting_id) = (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id)
        FROM job_postings
    )
),
requirement_details AS (
    
    SELECT
        r.requirement_type,
        r.value
    FROM requirements r
    JOIN common_requirements cr ON r.id = cr.requirement_id
),
min_values AS (
    
    SELECT
        requirement_type,
        MIN(
            CASE
                WHEN requirement_type IN ('Experience') THEN
                    
                    REGEXP_REPLACE(value, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')::INTEGER
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS min_numeric_value,
        
        MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE requirement_type NOT IN ('Experience')) AS min_text_value
    FROM requirement_details
    GROUP BY requirement_type
)

SELECT
    requirement_type,
    CASE
        WHEN min_numeric_value IS NOT NULL THEN min_numeric_value::TEXT
        ELSE min_text_value
    END AS min_value,
    TRUE AS is_common
FROM min_values
ORDER BY requirement_type;
